values.Objects_Developer_Description: Options used for development of the visual.
values.Objects_Developer_Version_Description: The current version of Deneb. Used to check for available updates.
values.Objects_Developer_Locale_Description: Provide a manual locale for the visual (to facilitate testing of i18n and formatting)
values.Objects_Display_Description: Options used to manage visual display.
values.Objects_Display_ScrollbarColor_Descripti: Color to shade the scrollbars (if displayed).
values.Objects_Display_ScrollbarRadius_Descript: Border radius of the scrollbars (if displayed).
values.Objects_Display_ScrollbarWidth_Descripti: Width of the scrollbars in pixels (if displayed).
values.Objects_Display_ScrollEventThrottle_Desc: In order to prevent scroll events from updating the Vega view more than necessary, this property allows you to specify a throttle time (in milliseconds) to prevent this.
values.Objects_StateManagement_SupportFieldConf: Persisted support field configuration as a JSON string.
values.Objects_StateManagement_DenebMetaVersion: Persisted deneb metadata version for legacy detection.
values.Objects_StateManagement_ScaleToZoom_Desc: When enabled and using canvas rendering, Deneb adjusts the canvas resolution to match the Power BI report zoom level. This produces sharper output at non-100% zoom but still may not be as reliable as SVG output. Only applies to canvas rendering mode.
values.Objects_StateManagement_ScaleToZoom_Disa: Only applies when the render mode is Canvas.
values.Objects_StateManagement_ConsolidateField: Whether to consolidate field parameter component fields into parameter-named array columns.
values.Objects_StateManagement_Description: Options used to manage the state of the visual.
values.Objects_StateManagement_ViewportHeight_D: Persisted viewport height (as per last eligible update).
values.Objects_StateManagement_ViewportWidth_De: Persisted viewport width (as per last eligible update).
values.Objects_Vega_RenderMode_Description: Specify how visuals should be rendered when processed. Canvas creates pixel graphics and SVG creates vector graphics. It is recommended to use Canvas if your visual needs to render many data points or marks, as this can reduce overhead on devices viewing the visual.
values.Objects_Vega_EnableTooltips_Description: If enabled, this will use Deneb's integration with Power BI tooltip APIs and attempt to resolve report page tooltips, if they are set up. If disabled, any tooltips will be displayed using Vega's tooltip handler.
values.Objects_Vega_EnableContextMenu_Descripti: For context (right-click) events, display Power BI's context menu. If disabled, Power BI's context menu will not be invoked, but any Vega event streams you have set up will still work as intended.
values.Objects_Vega_EnableContextMenuSelector: Attempt to resolve data point-specific actions
values.Objects_Vega_EnableContextMenuSelector_D: If the Power BI context menu is enabled, Deneb will attempt to resolve data points over any marks that are a target of the event and display context-specific actions, such as drillthrough, if they are set up in your report.
Turn on the context menu to use this.
values.Objects_Vega_EnableSelection: Expose cross-filtering values for dataset rows
values.Objects_Vega_EnableSelection_Description: Add support fields to the dataset that will allow Deneb to supply cross-filter state and allow you to provide functionality around this state.
values.Objects_Vega_EnableHighlight_Description: Instruct Deneb to provide both original and contextual (highlight) values for eligible measures.
values.Objects_Vega_SelectionMode_Description: Specify how Deneb should attempt to process cross-filter events.
values.Objects_Vega_SelectionMaxDataPoints_Desc: The most data points one selection can include.
values.Objects_Vega_TooltipDelay_Description: How long to wait before showing a tooltip while a multi-select key is held, so tooltips don't get in the way of selecting several data points.
values.Objects_Vega_TooltipDelay_DisabledReason: Turn on the Power BI tooltip handler to use this.
values.Objects_DataLimit_Description: Options for managing how data is loaded and processed by the visual.
values.Objects_DataLimit_Override_Description:
Allow loading of additional data from the model to the visual, if it is available.

Note that Power BI still may not be able to supply all data to your visual, depending on memory constraints.
values.Objects_DataLimit_ShowCustomVisualNotes_:
Display information about the custom visual limitations and recommendations for end users.

This option allows you to turn this info off for end-users if you feel it is not relevant to them.
values.Assistive_Text_Performance: These settings control rendering optimizations. When data patching is disabled, underlying data changes from embedded datasets will fully re-compile and re-embed the visualization (resetting all signals). Patching data and preserving signal values has a performance implication for large datasets and can only be used when datasets are small enough to avoid timeouts during change detection.
